name: four-hands-studio
description: Four Hands Studio: compose MIDI side by side with your own AI (prototype).

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/mcp-tools packages/bridge packages/desktop && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.capturas: npm run build -w @fourhands/desktop -- --harness && node packages/desktop/scripts/capturas.mjs capturas
scripts.puente: npm run build:bridge && npm run build -w @fourhands/desktop && xvfb-run -a node packages/desktop/scripts/puente.mjs
